name: Penang Bridge International Marathon
short_description: The Penang Bridge International Marathon is a full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km race held on the Penang Bridge in George Town, Malaysia on December 13, 2026.
ai_summary: The Penang Bridge International Marathon is a road race scheduled for December 13, 2026, taking place on the Penang Bridge in George Town, Malaysia. Organized by the Penang State Tourism Development office, the event offers three distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a 10 km race. Registration for the event is currently open, allowing runners to sign up for any of the three distances.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195 km, 21.1 km, and 10 km) accommodate different runner levels
Unique route across the iconic Penang Bridge
Organized by an official government body, the Penang State Tourism Development office
Registration is currently open, giving runners ample time to plan and sign up

faqs.question: When is the Penang Bridge International Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Penang Bridge International Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 13, 2026. It is held in George Town, Malaysia, on the Penang Bridge, and offers runners a full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km distance option on this date.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Penang Bridge International Marathon?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from three distances at the Penang Bridge International Marathon: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a shorter 10 km race, allowing participants of varying experience and fitness levels to take part.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Penang Bridge International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Penang Bridge International Marathon is organized by the Penang State Tourism Development office. This official body oversees the event, which is held on the Penang Bridge in George Town, Malaysia, offering full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km distances to participants.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Penang Bridge International Marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Penang Bridge International Marathon is currently open. Runners interested in participating in the full marathon, half marathon, or 10 km distance on December 13, 2026 in George Town, Malaysia can sign up now while spots remain available.
